about:
Twisted Apparel Co. is a family-owned and operated apparel shop based in Belle Fourche, South Dakota. Founded in 2017, the company began as a single-location customization studio offering a range of in-house decoration services.

The shop provides a full suite of customization processes under one roof, including screen printing, embroidery, laser engraving, UV printing, Aqua Fusion (direct-to-film printing), sublimation, and 3D printing. These capabilities allow the team to handle projects ranging from custom apparel and team gear to promotional items, drinkware, awards, and signage without outsourcing any production steps.

Twisted Apparel Co. primarily serves businesses and sports teams looking for branded merchandise and uniforms. The company also works with a network of wholesale suppliers such as SanMar, Storm Creek, S&S Activewear, Momentec Brands, JDS Industries, Richardson, and Wyld Gear to source blank goods for decoration.

The company emphasizes that all work is performed in-house with no middlemen, using premium materials to ensure durability. It highlights a personal touch, treating each order as its own, and creative execution that brings client ideas to life with bold design and sharp detail.
